summary: Ares Core Infrastructure Fund filed an 8-K reporting an unregistered sale of Common Shares across Class I, D, N and S for an aggregate $767.0 million in its September 2026 monthly closing. Pricing equals each class's August 31, 2026 NAV per share, expected within 20 business days after September 1, 2026. No underwriting discounts or commissions apply; selling agents may charge up to 2.0% NAV on Class D and N and 3.5% on Class S, with no load on Class I. Shares outstanding as of August 31, 2026 were disclosed under Item 8.01.
